biography.plain_text: Andreas Petrakis is a Greek shipowner and founder of Athens-based Iolcos Hellenic Maritime Enterprises. He established the business in 1982, acquired its first bulk carrier the following year and expanded through ship operations and sale-and-purchase transactions. Iolcos later entered newbuilding programmes, while his son Themis has since assumed day-to-day leadership.

long_biography.plain_text:
Andreas Petrakis built Iolcos Hellenic Maritime Enterprises around dry-bulk shipping. The Athens business grew from its first vessel through ship operations and a succession of sale-and-purchase transactions. By the end of the 1990s, it managed thirteen bulk carriers and had established an international ocean-transport operation.

Newbuilding programmes at Hudong carried Iolcos into a more capital-intensive stage of global expansion. Petrakis became a shareholder in numerous Malta-registered shipping companies connected to the Iolcos address. His son Themis now leads the business, whose specialist teams manage commercial, technical, operating and financial functions for an international bulk-carrier fleet.
